_comment: Descriptive connector manifest for humans/registration tooling — not a normative MCP protocol file. The live, authoritative tool schemas are served at runtime by mcp_server/server.py itself (FastMCP introspects the @mcp_app.tool()-decorated function signatures/docstrings).
name: transbench
description: TransBench -- a translational clinician<->bench research agent. Decomposes a clinical observation about antihypertensive drugs into biological axes, generates up to 3 falsifiable mechanistic hypotheses, grounds each in retrieved PubMed evidence (support + contradiction), applies a novelty guard (established/open_question/unsupported) so textbook facts are never shipped as novel, and designs ONE reproducible computational experiment naming a concrete, resolvable public dataset plus a claude_science_prompt. Research tool only -- never diagnosis, drug selection, or dosing advice; every response carries a fixed disclaimer.

stdio.note: the transport Claude Science spawns per CLAUDE_SCIENCE_SETUP.md Step 4

http.note: demo-day fallback only (CLAUDE_SCIENCE_SETUP.md); also try sdk_transport=sse if a client only speaks the older SSE transport -- both are supported by mcp==1.28.1

required.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: BYOK key for the ENGINE's own Anthropic calls (create_llm user_key) -- independent of Claude Science, which is only this tool's MCP client.

tools.name: generate_experiment
tools.summary: The showpiece. Full grounded TransBrief incl. one runnable computational experiment.
tools.returns: TransBrief (see src/transbench/schemas.py) on success; {error, message, status_code} on failure
tools.cost_note: ~13 LLM calls + live PubMed + live GEO verification per invocation (BUILD_SPEC.md §9)

tools.name: search_grounded_evidence
tools.summary: Utility/fallback. Same engine run as generate_experiment, reshaped into a lighter grounded-evidence projection (no axes/top_experiment/run_manifest).
tools.returns: {request_echo, hypotheses[{...,evidence[]}], references[], contradictions_surfaced[], uncertainty_note, disclaimer} on success; {error, message, status_code} on failure
tools.cost_note: same cost as generate_experiment -- it is the same full pipeline, only the RETURNED shape is lighter

disclaimer: Research hypothesis generation only. Not clinical, diagnostic, or prescribing advice.
